Alisa: quick ping — PR #14500 (feature/kv-cache-params) is passing locally but CI failed on linux-integration with a snapshot diff for tests/ui/render_header. any quick ideas? :thinking_face: ci-bot: GitHub Actions • linux-integration — failed: snapshot mismatch in tests/ui/render_header (1 failed). logs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/3194821 :robot_face: Ryan: can you paste the failing diff here? or a short snippet would help :eyes: Alisa: sure — pasted the small diff below: ``` -
Redwood
\n+
Redwood
\n``` looks like an extra trailing space got into the rendered html (only on CI). passed on my mac. Marco: hmmm that smells like a sanitizer or templating change. could be locale or newline normalization on the CI image. can you try a targeted rerun first? `gh run rerun 3194821` or click rerun in the actions UI. Ryan: I can queue the targeted job for that commit now. tagging @marco and @sanjay for visibility. ci-bot: Rerun queued by Ryan — linux-integration (job id: 3194821-2). ci-bot: Rerun completed — still failing with same snapshot diff. Olivia: would it be acceptable to update the snapshot if this is an intentional output change? looks tiny and cosmetic. :shrug: Sanjay: if it's intentional (third-party sanitizer bumped), we should update snapshots, but we need 2 approvals for snapshot updates per the merge policy. also add a note in changelog about sanitizer behavior. Alisa: I reproduced locally by running `./scripts/test-ui render_header` and confirmed the extra trailing space appears when I use the CI docker image (docker image: `redwood/ci:2026-02-14`). I ran `./scripts/update_snapshot.sh tests/ui/render_header` to accept the new output and tests pass locally. Ryan: thanks — to follow process: either we (a) fix the templating to normalize whitespace, or (b) accept snapshot change with 2 approvers. which do you prefer? Alisa: fix would be ideal but it's higher risk. this is just a whitespace quirk from upstream; I'd prefer to accept snapshot and note it. Marco: I'll do the second review if you add an explanation in the PR description and include the failing snippet and that you ran the update using the CI image. also remove any unrelated changes from the PR. Olivia: FYI we have the next merge window at 18:00 PST; if we want this in the next release, we need approvals + green CI before then. Sanjay: I'll take a quick look for the changelog blurb; if it's purely cosmetic I'm fine approving after Marco. Ryan: Alisa — please add a short note: "Snapshot update: whitespace normalization from html-sanitizer v2.3. Accepting harmless trailing-space change." and tag Marco + Sanjay. then we can re-run a full matrix if needed. Alisa: done — added note and labeled the PR `snapshot-update-needed`. kicked a full-matrix rerun: `gh actions run --rerun-id 3194800` (queued). ci-bot: Full matrix rerun started (run id: 3194900). ci-bot: linux-integration passed on rerun; two other jobs had transient flakes (test/kv_timeouts) — reran failing job automatically and it passed. overall status: passed. Marco: looks good to me, approving now. :thumbsup: Sanjay: approving as well. Alisa: awesome — thanks all. merging during the 18:00 PST window. I'll watch the post-merge smoke and revert if anything odd pops up. Ryan: great — thanks for moving quickly. leaving a note for next time: consider normalizing trailing whitespace in the renderer to avoid snapshot churn. :memo: Olivia: cheers — good coordination. ci-bot: Merge queued and will land during merge window.
